name: Crispy Tofu Sandwich with Garlic-Tartar Sauce & Side Salad
instructions: Cut the tofu into ¼-inch thick planks along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; mince capers. Transfer both to a small bowl along with mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the tartar sauce; set aside.
Combine oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a large salad bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rounds. Set half of the onions aside on a plate. Add the other half to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Wash and dry the tomatoes, then halve and slice them. Place half of the tomatoes on the plate; transfer the other half to the salad bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts; transfer to the salad bowl. Set aside while you prepare the tofu.
Combine soy sauce, cornstarch, mayo, and spices in medium bowl; beat with a whisk or fork until smooth.
Place bread crumbs in a second medium bowl.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Dip each tofu plank into the cornstarch mixture, turning to coat. Next, dip into the bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate lined with paper towel. Cook in batches if necessary.
Wash and dry the lettuce; separate the leaves. Set aside 2 large leaves per sandwich. Chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces, add to the salad bowl and toss to combine.
Place the bottom half of a roll on each plate. Layer with tartar sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion, and crispy tofu; close with top half of the roll. Serve salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
